verdict.rationale: Yubico's own SDK docs confirm NFC support for both Android (yubikit-android supports USB and NFC-enabled YubiKeys) and iOS (yubikit-ios provides NFC OTP requests), and YubiKey's core FIDO2/WebAuthn/passkey stack (docs-27, docs-14, docs-16) is the basis for authenticating in mobile browsers/apps, but the evidence is SDK/developer-facing rather than an end-user confirmation that a stock mobile browser/app tap-to-auth flow just works. missing for 10: an explicit first-party or hands-on claim that end-users can tap NFC on a phone in a mobile browser (not just app SDK) to authenticate, and independent/community corroboration of real-world NFC mobile browser use.
